subtitle: Websites, online stores, mobile apps. One person to understand your business, one to build your solution.

heroCards.title: Business websites
heroCards.text: An online presence that looks like you.

heroCards.title: Custom software
heroCards.text: Because no two businesses are alike.

services.title: Complete digital solutions for every project.
services.lead: From first sketch to launch day, we walk you through every step and turn your ideas into digital products that perform.

models.title: Sites already online, that you can test right now.
models.lead: Our competitors show screenshots. We give you the link: open the demo, click everywhere, try it on your phone. Every template can be tailored to your business.

difference.title: Digital, with no middleman.
difference.lead: In a large agency your project travels through a salesperson, a project manager, a studio and then a technical team. Something is lost at every handover. Here, there is nobody between you and the solution.

points.title: One business contact
points.text: Manon has known your project since the first call. You never have to explain your needs twice.

points.title: Direct access to the developer
points.text: A technical question? You talk to the person writing the code, not to someone who will pass it on.

points.title: No subcontracting
points.text: Your project is never resold to a third party. What you see is who does the work.

points.title: You own the code
points.text: Source code, accounts, hosting: everything is in your name. You are never locked in.

duo.title: Two skill sets. One goal: making your project succeed.
duo.lead: No fake agency of thirty people. Two people, whom you know by name, from the first call to launch day.

people.name: Manon
people.text: First contact, understanding your needs, quotes, planning and follow-up. She turns your business into a brief and stays your point of reference throughout the project.

people.name: Christopher
people.text: Architecture, technical UX, web and mobile development, integrations, performance, deployment and maintenance. He builds what you signed off.

method.title: You always know where your project stands.
method.lead: Eight steps, regular progress updates, and never a moment where you wonder what is happening.

steps.title: We listen
steps.text: A conversation to understand your business, your customers and what you actually expect.

steps.title: We scope
steps.text: Goals, features, budget and timeline agreed in writing before a single line is written.

steps.title: We build
steps.text: Step-by-step development, with regular demos and your feedback folded in as we go.

steps.title: We support
steps.text: Launch, hands-on training, then maintenance and new features.
